descriptions.IC50: Antiviral activity against Vaccinia virus Copenhagen infected in African green monkey Vero cells assessed as inhibition of viral replication after 4 days by neural red dye-based spectrophotometric method
descriptions.CC50: Cytotoxicity against African green monkey Vero cells assessed as reduction in cell viability after 4 days by neural red dye-based spectrophotometric method
descriptions.SI: Selectivity index, ratio of CC50 for African green monkey Vero cells to IC50 for Vaccinia virus Copenhagen infected in African green monkey Vero cells

policy: Published exact SI kept distinct from concentrations; only consistent triples may become matched labels.
